# Construct PGIs for all Observed/Imputed

- 14 GWAS weights sets

```{bash Test Case: Single GWAS}
conda activate SNIPar_GP2_py38
BGEN_PATH=~/sniparV2_analysis/sniparV2_unipar_bgen
HDF5_PATH=~/sniparV2_analysis/sniparV2_unipar_hdf5
WGTS_PATH=~/gwas_weights/ldpred2_final/Current_Versions
PGI_OUT=sniparV2_analysis/sniparV2_unipar_pgs/1pg_set
## Matched to prefix of desired weights file
## Also used as prefix of output PGI file
GWAS_PHENO=bmi_ukb

pgs.py \
  ${PGI_OUT}/${GWAS_PHENO}_ldpred2 \
  --bgen ${BGEN_PATH}/chr@_final \
  --imp ${HDF5_PATH}/final_chr@ \
  --grandpar \
  --weights ${WGTS_PATH}/${GWAS_PHENO}_wgts.txt \
  --chr_range 1-22 \
  --SNP CHRPOS \
  --beta_col BETA_LDPRED2 \
  --A1 A1 \
  --A2 A2 \
  --threads 30
```

```{bash Final: All GWAS}
## For all GWAS (start index 0, vector length 14): ${GWAS_PHENO_VEC[*]:0:14}
## Modify vector start/length values for subset of available GWAS
GWAS_PHENO_VEC=(adhd afb_repo afb_ukb cpd_cur_ukb cpd_liu cpd_prev_ukb dep_howard ea4 bmi_ukb
                evrsmk_ukb hgt_ukb neb_ukb neb_wom_repo smkfrq_cur_ukb)
BGEN_PATH=~/sniparV2_analysis/sniparV2_unipar_bgen
HDF5_PATH=~/sniparV2_analysis/sniparV2_unipar_hdf5
WGTS_PATH=~/gwas_weights/ldpred2_final/Current_Versions
PGI_OUT=sniparV2_analysis/sniparV2_unipar_pgs/1pg_set

for GWAS in ${GWAS_PHENO_VEC[*]:7:6}; do \
pgs.py \
    ${PGI_OUT}/${GWAS}_ldpred2 \
    --bgen ${BGEN_PATH}/chr@_final \
    --imp ${HDF5_PATH}/final_chr@ \
    --grandpar \
    --weights ${WGTS_PATH}/${GWAS}_wgts.txt \
    --chr_range 1-22 \
    --SNP CHRPOS \
    --beta_col BETA_LDPRED2 \
    --A1 A1 \
    --A2 A2 \
    --threads 15; \
done
```
